      "unit": "F093",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall assist in coordinating the State public employment service offices throughout the country and in increasing their usefulness by developing and prescribing minimum standards of efficiency, assisting them in meeting problems peculiar to their localities, promoting uniformity in their administrative and statistical procedure, furnishing and publishing information as to opportunities for employment and other information of value in the operation of the system, and maintaining a system for clearing labor between the States.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null

    {
      "unit": "F096",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary",
          "t_state"
        ],
        "statement": "It shall be the duty of the Secretary to assure that unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act, or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, shall furnish to such agency making the request, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.",
        "actor": "Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.], or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.)",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F096"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be the duty",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "part A of title IV of the Social Security Act",
          "part D of title IV of such Act",
          "Food and Nutrition Act of 2008"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_state"
        ],
        "statement": "Notwithstanding any other provision of law, unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, are authorized, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act, or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, to furnish to such agency making the request, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.",
        "actor": "unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State",
        "actor_quote": "unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.], or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.)",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F096"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "is authorized to",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "part A of title IV of the Social Security Act",
          "part D of title IV of such Act",
          "Food and Nutrition Act of 2008"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F099",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary",
          "t_state"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall assist in the coordination and development of a nationwide system of public labor exchange services, provided as part of the one-stop customer service systems of the States.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": [
          "F098"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F100",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall assist in the development of continuous improvement models for such nationwide system of public labor exchange services that ensure private sector satisfaction with the system and meet the demands of jobseekers relating to the system, and identify and disseminate information on best practices for such system.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": [

        "choice_text": null,

        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F102",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall ensure, for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation, the provision of reemployment services and other activities in which the individuals are required to participate to receive the compensation.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F102"
        ],
        "context_quotes": [
          "F098"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,

        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F104",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary",
          "t_state_agency",
          "t_workforce_development_activity",
          "t_workplace_learning_advisor"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall, in coordination with the State agencies and the staff of such agencies, assist in the planning and implementation of activities to enhance the professional development and career advancement opportunities of such staff, in order to strengthen the provision of a broad range of career guidance services, the identification of job openings (including providing intensive outreach to small and medium-sized employers and enhanced employer services), the provision of technical assistance and training to other providers of workforce development activities (including workplace learning advisors) relating to counseling and employment-related services, and the development of new strategies for coordinating counseling and technology.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": [
          "F098"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F107",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_employment_service_office",
          "t_state",
          "t_one_stop_center"
        ],
        "statement": "In order to improve service delivery, avoid duplication of services, and enhance coordination of services, including location of staff to ensure access to services under section 49f(a) of this title statewide in underserved areas, employment service offices in each State shall be colocated with one-stop centers.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order to improve service delivery, avoid duplication of services, and enhance coordination of services, including location of staff to ensure access to services under section 49f(a) of this title statewide in underserved areas",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F107"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 49f(a) of this title"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F109:F111",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "t_secretary",
          "t_state",
          "t_one_stop_delivery_system"
        ],
        "statement": "The Secretary, in consultation with States, is authorized to assist the States in the development of national electronic tools that may be used to improve access to workforce information for individuals through (1) the one-stop delivery systems established as described in section 3151(e) of this title; and (2) such other delivery systems as the Secretary determines to be appropriate.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "authority",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "in consultation with States",
        "scope_quotes": [

      }

  ]
}

For purposes of this chapter, the term "one-stop delivery system" means a one-stop delivery system described in section 3151(e) of this title.
For purposes of this chapter, the term "Secretary" means the Secretary of Labor.
For purposes of this chapter, the term "State" means any of the several States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Guam, and the Virgin Islands.
For purposes of this chapter, the term "employment service office" means a local office of a State agency.

For purposes of this chapter, except in section 49l–2 of this title, the term "State agency", used without further description, means an agency designated or authorized under section 49c of this title.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall assist in coordinating the State public employment service offices throughout the country and in increasing their usefulness by developing and prescribing minimum standards of efficiency, assisting them in meeting problems peculiar to their localities, promoting uniformity in their administrative and statistical procedure, furnishing and publishing information as to opportunities for employment and other information of value in the operation of the system, and maintaining a system for clearing labor between the States.

It shall be the duty of the Secretary to assure that unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act, or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, shall furnish to such agency making the request, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall assist in the coordination and development of a nationwide system of public labor exchange services, provided as part of the one-stop customer service systems of the States.

The Secretary shall assist in the development of continuous improvement models for such nationwide system of public labor exchange services that ensure private sector satisfaction with the system and meet the demands of jobseekers relating to the system, and identify and disseminate information on best practices for such system.

The Secretary shall ensure, for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation, the provision of reemployment services and other activities in which the individuals are required to participate to receive the compensation.
unit_attributes.scope_text: for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall, in coordination with the State agencies and the staff of such agencies, assist in the planning and implementation of activities to enhance the professional development and career advancement opportunities of such staff, in order to strengthen the provision of a broad range of career guidance services, the identification of job openings (including providing intensive outreach to small and medium-sized employers and enhanced employer services), the provision of technical assistance and training to other providers of workforce development activities (including workplace learning advisors) relating to counseling and employment-related services, and the development of new strategies for coordinating counseling and technology.

In order to improve service delivery, avoid duplication of services, and enhance coordination of services, including location of staff to ensure access to services under section 49f(a) of this title statewide in underserved areas, employment service offices in each State shall be colocated with one-stop centers.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary, in consultation with States, is authorized to assist the States in the development of national electronic tools that may be used to improve access to workforce information for individuals through (1) the one-stop delivery systems established as described in section 3151(e) of this title; and (2) such other delivery systems as the Secretary determines to be appropriate.
